say:2:1630139002:1.text: She had that same strange affliction, and they kicked her out, just like that...
say:2:1630139002:1.source_cn: 她也得了那种怪病，被守卫驱逐了……
say:2:1630139002:1.male: She had that same strange affliction, and they kicked her out, just like that...
say:2:1630139002:1.female: She had that same strange affliction, and they kicked her out, just like that...

say:3:1630139003:1.text: Okay fine, I didn't like her. After her magic got stronger, she was always strutting around like she'd just been crowned Empress of the Arcane...
say:3:1630139003:1.source_cn: 我承认我有点讨厌她。自从她的魔力变强后她就变得很自大，...
say:3:1630139003:1.male: Okay fine, I didn't like her. After her magic got stronger, she was always strutting around like she'd just been crowned Empress of the Arcane...
say:3:1630139003:1.female: Okay fine, I didn't like her. After her magic got stronger, she was always strutting around like she'd just been crowned Empress of the Arcane...

say:4:1630139004:1.text: And she always played innocent—"Who, me? I wasn't even trying..." And somehow, that made losing to her feel even worse.
say:4:1630139004:1.source_cn: 她会装作“我什么都没做呀，感觉也没有很厉害”的样子……...
say:4:1630139004:1.male: And she always played innocent—"Who, me? I wasn't even trying..." And somehow, that made losing to her feel even worse.
say:4:1630139004:1.female: And she always played innocent—"Who, me? I wasn't even trying..." And somehow, that made losing to her feel even worse.

say:5:1630139005:1.text: But then I think about it... She was expelled. No more magic, no more power—just an ordinary person, overnight.
say:5:1630139005:1.source_cn: 但是……一想到她已经退学，就此成为一个没有魔力的普通人……
say:5:1630139005:1.male: But then I think about it... She was expelled. No more magic, no more power—just an ordinary person, overnight.
say:5:1630139005:1.female: But then I think about it... She was expelled. No more magic, no more power—just an ordinary person, overnight.

say:6:1630139006:1.text: I can't even picture what she must be going through...
say:6:1630139006:1.male: I can't even picture what she must be going through...
say:6:1630139006:1.female: I can't even picture what she must be going through...
